title_zh: 不以性取向解释虚构人物分居

scenario.label_zh: 虚构人物介绍的因果边界
scenario.goal_zh: 核对分居情节并约定删去缺乏依据的因果暗示

context_zh: 编辑 Nia 与作者 Hugo 讨论一部虚构小说中成年双性恋人物的介绍文字。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Nia
sentences.text: This sentence makes her sexuality sound like the cause of the separation.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: That wasn’t my intention. Her spouse takes a job overseas, and they agree to live apart for a year.

sentences.speaker: Nia
sentences.text: Then say that. Linking the separation to her being bisexual repeats a stereotype the story itself doesn’t support.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: I can keep the identity detail elsewhere, without making it an explanation for their living arrangements.

sentences.speaker: Nia
sentences.text: Exactly. The introduction should follow the events in the chapter.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: I’ll rewrite these two sentences with the overseas job as the stated reason.
